sections.title: Identity and boundaries
sections.intro: Core draft fields may truthfully record work that is not yet executed. No field grants qualification.

fields.label: Student and group
fields.help: GROUP | Surname | GivenName; no identity document data.

fields.label: Package and source identity
fields.help: S09 version/PACKAGE_ID and source/diff locators, never a hash guessed from a filename.

fields.label: Actual environment
fields.help: Node/npm, operating system, browser where used; prescribed pins are not observations.

fields.label: Evidence classes
fields.help: Label every witness SOURCE / MODEL / REACT_TEST / HTTP_LOOPBACK / REAL_BROWSER / NOT_EXECUTED. One summary label cannot upgrade other witnesses.

fields.label: Blocks and limits
fields.help: Missing dependencies and blocked runs stay visible; no automatic replacement by a model.

fields.label: Permitted paths
fields.help: P01 src/NotesApp.jsx; P03 server/create-production-app.js; P02 client/src/NotesWorkspace.jsx for later capstone integration.

sections.title: P01 ownership and prediction
sections.intro: Core draft fields may truthfully record work that is not yet executed. No field grants qualification.

fields.label: Pre-experiment prediction
fields.help: Action, initial route and falsifying observation; retrospective notes explicitly labelled.

fields.label: Exact seed and route fixture
fields.help: Use canonical seed 1/2; new store lifetime is distinct from reload of durable data.

fields.label: Route and parameter ownership
fields.help: URL owns route/id; distinguish query from draft.

fields.label: Push/replace expectation
fields.help: Specify stack before/after action and cancel; do not infer replacement merely from final URL.

fields.label: Shared controlled form
fields.help: Draft initialisation, trim/blank boundary and no-write cancel; missing edit target.

sections.title: P01 individual evidence
sections.intro: Core draft fields may truthfully record work that is not yet executed. No field grants qualification.

fields.label: Direct-route trace
fields.help: Initial URL, exact fixture, visible state, actual evidence locator and class.

fields.label: Link/back/forward witness
fields.help: Record stack-sensitive observation after submit/cancel; no browser claim for MemoryRouter only.

fields.label: Create and local validation
fields.help: Blank and trimmed input, writes/navigation and returned id.

fields.label: Edit identity and reset
fields.help: Addressed id, saved title/body, direct edit-id change and no body id override.

fields.label: Missing note and unknown route
fields.help: Distinguish missing data from unknown client path and server missing document.

fields.label: Named actual checks
fields.help: Baseline/objective/regression/build/browser with exact command, outcome, source identity and locators. Unexecuted stays unexecuted.

fields.label: Whole P01 status
fields.help: NOT_STARTED / IN_PROGRESS / COMPLETE_RECORDED; completeness remains teacher-assessed.

sections.title: P03 required repair portfolio
sections.intro: Core draft fields may truthfully record work that is not yet executed. No field grants qualification.

fields.label: Delivery prediction
fields.help: Predict representative method/path/Accept before observation.

fields.label: Static-only witness
fields.help: Status, content type, body kind and request trace; actual missing deep link where executed.

fields.label: Universal witness
fields.help: Use a genuinely affected asset/method case; do not fabricate a broken API control.

fields.label: API control
fields.help: Known/unknown API status/envelope and pipeline; preserved router may already return JSON 404.

fields.label: Eligibility matrix
fields.help: GET/HEAD; root/nested; API boundary; existing/missing asset; non-HTML/non-GET; 404/500 distinctions.

fields.label: Actual middleware order
fields.help: Link order to request-log entries rather than a generic diagram.

fields.label: One-file repair
fields.help: Causal explanation and concise diff; no full hidden answer key. Keep built/evidence/tests byte-identical.

fields.label: Asset and fixture identity
fields.help: Compare exact hashes and bytes; a marker or hash-looking filename is insufficient.

fields.label: Actual P03 checks
fields.help: Named baseline/objective/regression, HTTP traces and real nested browser boot separately; failure classes and limits.

sections.title: Bounded AI critique and independent check
sections.intro: Core draft fields may truthfully record work that is not yet executed. No field grants qualification.

fields.label: Actual exchange status
fields.help: ACTUAL_RECORDED / PENDING / separately authorised alternative, never fabricated practice.

fields.label: Sanitised bounded prompt
fields.help: One claim based on own trace/diff; no private routes, tokens or entire conversations.

fields.label: Relevant response excerpt
fields.help: Keep only the claim under evaluation; no invented dialogue.

fields.label: Independent evaluation
fields.help: Falsifiable check not another paraphrase by the same model; source/test/trace with locator.

fields.label: Verdict
fields.help: ACCEPTED / REJECTED / PARTIALLY ACCEPTED / UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN is not task PASS.

fields.label: Correction and limitation
fields.help: Correct only the supported claim and record remaining uncertainty.

sections.title: P02 semester integration, not a second S09 implementation gate
sections.intro: P02 is capstone integration, not a second full S09 completion gate. Blank implementation evidence is allowed.

fields.label: Server/UI/submission mapping
fields.help: Conceptual transfer for the semester milestone; no second full build in class.

fields.label: Capstone progress
fields.help: NOT_STARTED is allowed for this separate implementation at the S09 evidence stage; do not claim completed integration.

fields.label: Available capstone evidence
fields.help: Use evidence only if actually produced; blank does not deduct the S09 P01/P03 rubric.

sections.title: Reflection, PDF and declaration
sections.intro: Core draft fields may truthfully record work that is not yet executed. No field grants qualification.

fields.label: Learning transfer
fields.help: Explain one changed mental model and a boundary still untested.

fields.label: Evidence locator index
fields.help: All cited captures/logs fit in the same PDF; no external private repository required.

fields.label: Unfinished work
fields.help: Required P01/P03/AI work versus separate capstone work; no hidden promotion to final.

fields.label: Prior authorisation if relevant
fields.help: Record actual prior teacher decision and replacement evidence; a text field cannot authorise or authenticate it.

fields.label: Draft/export/review state
fields.help: A print request does not demonstrate a saved, readable PDF or Moodle submission.

fields.label: Individual accuracy declaration
fields.help: False by default; reset after import or relevant edits.

fields.label: Limit of the evidence
fields.help: Acknowledge model/stub versus React/HTTP/browser and source identity limits.
